fact: WHO's Comoros results report for 2025 states that DHIS2 was extended to 91 public health structures, 100% of the structures at public level, and that in 2025 validation rules were integrated into DHIS2, a data quality self-assessment (DQS) was carried out and the national health information bulletin was delivered for three quarters of 2025.
title: Rapport annuel des résultats 2025 — OMS Comores
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau de pays des Comores
